text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas. While setting up the venue
with Meisho Doto for a modest party...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Lu~♪
Holy day...♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...♪
Happy, holy, day...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto kept humming a strange song
under her breath... And once preparations were complete—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so haaappy.
Getting to celebrate Christmas at a party
with everyone like this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Before coming to Tracen Academy,
I couldn't just hang out with close friends like this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? Well, umm...
To put it simply, I didn't really have any friends~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I couldn't make any. I never lived in the same place for very long, you see.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
As for Christmas party memories,
I suppose there was only that one time with my parents on the shuttle.
choice_data_list: Shuttle flight? Is that a plane?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeees.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I had to move from
place to place because of my father's work.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'd try hard to make friends only to part ways, over and over again.
That's why I rarely
ever get invited to parties and things like that.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even so, I kept trying to make it without giving up, but in the end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how lonely I looked, Mom and Dad
surprised me with a secret Christmas on the airplane.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The only food was glazed carrots and juice.
Even so, we had a fun time quietly singing Christmas carols together...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Lu~♪ Holy day...♪
Wa~♪ Happy, holy, day...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I learned the secret origin behind that mysterious song.
And at the same time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood one of the reasons why Meisho Doto
struggled to gain confidence. It must have been
a constant cycle of building it up only to have it crumble.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: “Oh, but that's all in the past now♪ I have so many friends who come visit me these days.”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Are they here yet, are they here yet~? Is everyone coming yet~?
I wrote '30 minutes before' on the invitations, so it should be any minute now..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaagh!
I forgot to send out the invitatiiiiiooons!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An anguished scream. If I forgot to cry out,
no one would ever come. If that's the case, today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, it's just like old times~~~. Just the two of us, all alone with my Trainer who's like family...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, we're doing a full chorus~~~!
Luuuuuu! Happpyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-a-ling!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, did someone... come?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Is this the party venue?
So sorry for being late!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The party's MC is Doto-san, yes!
Let's start!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh, an invitation that shouldn't have arrived
actually showed up?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What is the meaning of this, Trainer?
Was I actually handing them out without knowing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Or did Trainer-san
deliver it for me?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What? The invitation card
hasn't arrived yet. But...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was just passing by and sensed a party,
so here I am! If we're doing this,
then it's no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It seemed she'd only jumped in
after sensing someone's presence. And with that..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me~ So this is the venue for the secret Holy Night animal play session...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh, was I wrong? It's like someone's
Christmas party or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aha, well excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow☆ Nature,
nice timing!
Let's celebrate Christmas togeth-er.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh... are you sure?
I don't really have any connection to this.
Isn't this Doto's party?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees, please feel free to enjoy yourself
if you'd like~. Hardly anyone's come by yet.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't many animals...
B-But we do have raccoon dogs at least!"

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Whuff, whuff...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto used to have no friends.
But now she has Taiki Shuttle and Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—there's a tanuki.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you... doing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Oh, Ayabe-san...
You came for me?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we haven't even sent out invitations yet,
so how...?”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think an invitation is necessary at this point.
I mean..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't do anything,
they're bound to call me over anyway.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Welcome to my Christmas party! It seems the guest of honor has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san.
Wasn't this party originally organized by Doto-san's fans...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, the capacity's not enough. That's why I told you we should've gone with a bigger place.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Capa? What's capa~?
Ah, do you mean capelin, like fish eggs?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to competing with you at the Arima~
I'll be joining you today by way of introduction, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, wh-wh-what is this~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed there was no need for me to step in after all.
Meisho Doto has so many people looking out for her now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, O Doto. Christmas is upon us!
Lead the greeting and toast for our packed house of fans!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeeeeeek...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for coming today,
especially for someone... like meee, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm clumsy, slow, foolish, and useless,
I'm truly so very happy~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Alright, raise your glasses,
cheeeeers!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaah!
It got on my head!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone laughed at the predictable turn of events.
Surrounded by countless fans,
the heartwarming celebration went on and on.
